newsitem.title: USA: Troy, NY gets $5 mln grant for development - paper.
newsitem.headline: Troy, NY gets $5 mln grant for development - paper.

text.p: Troy, N.Y., which a rating agency has said is at risk of defaulting on a $1.4 million payment, has won a $5 million federal grant for economic development, the Troy Record said.
The federal Housing and Urban Development grant, which will be paid over three years, will be used for Troy's Enterprise Community Zone, the paper said.
A variety of projects will be funded, including $1.5 million of assistance for small and medium-sized businesses in downtown and central Troy.
Another 40 communities throughout the state also got Housing and Urban Development grants, the paper said, adding the list includes $514,025 for Hoosick Falls.
Troy, which has a population of around 55,000, has said it lacks the funds to make a $1.4 million on $35 million of debt that is due on September 15.

While the town is continuing to negotiate with bondholders, Moody's Investors Service has said that even if the Troy gets the bondholders to agree to a deferred payment, the agency still would consider that a default.
